processes.name: sensor node
processes.description: A deployed sensor node that publishes readings and polls for firmware updates.

processes.name: device gateway
processes.description: An MQTT broker that receives sensor readings and forwards accepted readings.

processes.name: telemetry normalizer
processes.description: A Python consumer that processes readings from Pub/Sub.

data_stores.name: device registry
data_stores.description: A Firestore registry containing device keys and customer associations.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The gateway looks up the device in a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to.

data_stores.name: Pub/Sub
data_stores.description: A Pub/Sub service carrying accepted sensor readings to the telemetry normalizer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_stores.name: telemetry lake
data_stores.description: A BigQuery data store containing site addresses and occupancy patterns.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns in it, so it is customer data.

data_stores.name: Cloud Storage bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket containing firmware images for sensor nodes to retrieve.
data_stores.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image
data_stores.notes: The bucket is public read. It is unknown whether nodes check a signature on the image before installing it.
